title: Epic: bounded smart buffering for transient contention
description: Four targeted buffering improvements where dropping wastes already-invested airtime or where blockage is demonstrably transient. Principle: buffer only where dropping wastes already-invested airtime (fragments, retransmissions) or where blockage is demonstrably transient and bounded (gateway uplink blip, DAO storm). Never buffer to hide sustained congestion. Current drop policies (TX queue at 4, forward buffer per-source limit, deadline expiry) remain correct and unchanged. Children: (1) RX staging ring for fragment reassembly during TX, (2) DAO storm window after topology change, (3) CON retransmit affinity tiebreaker, (4) gateway uplink holdoff buffer.
